compressionProtocol.bundle: USTAR; index first, blob SHA order; mode0644, uid/gid/mtime0, empty owner names

compressionScope: One merged program dictionary per native source and codec mode; index and unique ONLRSP blobs only. Native reports, source-job aliases, raw datasets, requests and build inputs are excluded.
scope: Every master chart/difficulty in both pinned published regional catalogues is accounted for; every natural LUCK chart has the complete native base/single source-level catalogue and four verified program archives. All team combinations and arbitrary play profiles are not pre-enumerated.
timingMeaning: Sums of recorded per-chart process elapsed and native phase counters across independent CI workers; neither sum is end-to-end workflow wall time. Charts were not re-run locally.
